newsitem.title: UK: Cotton prices steady to slightly firmer in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Cotton prices steady to slightly firmer in Europe.

text.p: Raw cotton values sustained their recent firmness in European markets lead by Central Asian types which were quoted steady to 0.50 cents higher, industry sources said.
Price movement was restricted by the futures market holiday in the U.S, especially given the lack of fundamental news, they said.
Turkish Adana and selected African cottons continued to attract buyer interest but while some millowners were still said to be seeking to cover nearby requirements.
